note: Post-#169 automation contracts are intentionally not production-reachable. This fragment records the exact external condition that must exist before each contract can be wired; the canonical ratchet merges this fragment with the base registry and rejects conflicts.

NO_BROWSER_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION.description: The browser-action contract can cross arbitrary application boundaries and can create irreversible or uncertain external effects. No scoped browser-action authority or target allowlist is currently active.
NO_BROWSER_ACTION_AUTHORIZATION.releasedBy: Explicit current owner authority bound to a named target, action class and consequence ceiling, plus an authenticated adapter that can prove reconciliation for uncertain effects.

NO_LIVE_VOICE_PROVIDER.description: The voice and telephony contract models real calls, transfers and SMS recovery, but no live telephony provider identity, credential, policy grant or canary receipt exists.
NO_LIVE_VOICE_PROVIDER.releasedBy: A terms-confirmed telephony provider with server-side credentials, bounded owner authority and at least one provider receipt from an explicitly authorized canary.

src/accounting-ledger-export-contract.mj.reason: The ledger exporter is derivative of canonical cleared commercial receipts. With no real commercial event to post, wiring it would manufacture bookkeeping activity from synthetic state.

src/booking-calendar-contract.mjs.reason: A booking consequence needs a real customer or lead requirement and provider-confirmed calendar truth; there is currently no customer relationship to schedule.

src/browser-action-contract.mjs.reason: The contract deliberately has no live arbitrary-browser caller until a target-scoped authority and reconciliation-capable adapter exist.

src/commercial-signature-contract.mjs.reason: A commercial signature lifecycle requires a real counterparty and signer-evidence context; no verified customer or live signing transaction exists.

src/external-crm-sync-contract.mjs.reason: External CRM synchronization is meaningful only for a real commercial relationship and must never become the source of truth before one exists.

src/form-feedback-contract.mjs.reason: Form and feedback ingestion is isolated from payment, acceptance, consent and authority truth until a real customer or respondent context exists.

src/omnichannel-communication-contract.m.reason: Person-targeted and public communication consequences remain unreachable until explicit channel-and-audience authority, suppression and consent evidence are present.

src/receivables-contract.mjs.reason: Receivables truth depends on real invoice and provider payment evidence. No connected payment provider or real provider event exists to reconcile.

src/social-publication-schedule-contract.reason: Scheduled social publication composes the canonical communication consequence boundary and must remain unreachable without explicit current publishing authority.

src/voice-telephony-contract.mjs.reason: Calls, transfers and SMS recovery remain provider-neutral planning and truth contracts until a live telephony provider and authorized canary produce external receipts.

src/web-context-extraction-contract.mjs.reason: The scale-extraction boundary needs a licensed, policy-compliant discovery adapter with provenance and robots evidence; none is configured for live extraction.
